SELECT m.id,m.menu_name,m.parent_id, CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(b.id,'-',b.button_name))) AS buttons FROM sys_menu_tenant m LEFT JOIN sys_button_tenant b ON b.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_resource_api_tenant ra ON (ra.resource_id = m.id AND ra.resource_type = 'MENU') OR (ra.resource_id = b.id AND ra.resource_type = 'BUTTON') WHERE m.be_unauth = 0 OR b.be_unauth = 0 GROUP BY m.id

SELECT CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(srr.role_id)) role_ids, api.req_url, api.req_method FROM sys_resource_api_tenant api LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_role_resource srr ON api.resource_id = srr.resource_id AND api.resource_type = srr.resource_type LEFT JOIN sys_button_tenant sb ON srr.resource_id = sb.id WHERE api.resource_type = 'BUTTON' AND sb.be_unauth = 0 GROUP BY api.req_url, api.req_method

SELECT api.req_url, api.req_method FROM sys_resource_api_tenant api INNER JOIN sys_button_tenant sb ON api.resource_id = sb.id WHERE api.resource_type = 'BUTTON' AND sb.be_unauth = 1 GROUP BY api.req_url, api.req_method

SELECT DISTINCT sb.id,sb.menu_id,sb.button_name, sb.sub_menu, IFNULL(sbp.perm_scope, 'CURRENT_USER') AS perm_scope, bp.id as perm_id, sbp.perm_start_time, sbp.perm_end_time, bp.perm_action FROM sys_button_tenant sb INNER JOIN sys_tenant_role_resource srr ON sb.id = srr.resource_id AND srr.resource_type = 'BUTTON' INNER JOIN sys_tenant_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = srr.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_business_perm_tenant bp on bp.button_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user_business_perm sbp on sbp.perm_id = bp.id AND ur.user_id = sbp.user_id AND sbp.org_id = ur.org_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=CHAR} AND ur.org_id = #{orgId,jdbcType=CHAR} and srr.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=CHAR} ORDER BY sb.sub_menu DESC

SELECT DISTINCT sb.id,sb.menu_id,sb.button_name, sb.sub_menu, IFNULL(sbp.perm_scope, 'CURRENT_USER') AS perm_scope, bp.id as perm_id, sbp.perm_start_time, sbp.perm_end_time, bp.perm_action FROM sys_button_tenant sb INNER JOIN sys_tenant_role_resource srr ON sb.id = srr.resource_id AND srr.resource_type = 'BUTTON' INNER JOIN sys_tenant_uset_role ur ON ur.role_id = srr.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_business_perm_tenant bp on bp.button_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_uset_business_perm sbp on sbp.perm_id = bp.id AND ur.uset_id = sbp.uset_id WHERE ur.uset_id = #{usetId,jdbcType=CHAR} and srr.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=CHAR} ORDER BY sb.sub_menu DESC
